testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel adaptive feature options: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:716:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel adaptive feature options ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And an extrusion in the MCAD Software has Feature Properties open ✔ And the Adaptive Sketch and Parameters options are unchecked ✔ And From/To Planes is disabled for this extrusion ✔ When the user checks Sketch and Parameters ✔ Then both options are checked ✔ And From/To Planes remains disabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel and reopens Feature Properties ✔ Then Sketch and Parameters are unchecked ✔ And From/To Planes remains disabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes and the solid remains visible
